A_gratitude_farewell.a: I'm the SIS assistant for the Tamil Nadu Survey Department. I can help with applications of every service code and their status, the mutation workflow, field visits, owner and patta details, sub-divisions, and your jurisdiction. Try: 'my pending applications', 'F-Line applications', 'approved plus rejected', 'which service code has the most', 'my field visits this week', or 'what is service code 0154'. You're very welcome! 😊 Feel free to ask if you need anything else regarding your survey work.
Goodbye! 👋 Thank you — come back any time you need an application, a survey number or a field visit looked up. Have a good day.
